remarks: A beautiful home at the end of a peaceful Cul de sac in one of Westport's most popular locations features abundant gardens, a courtyard perfect for entertaining and a private heated pool surrounded by extensive stonework. Inside, the home's sun-filled open plan easily accommodates friends and family. Main floor features updated kitchen as its center which flows to family room with fireplace, ample dining room and living room. Upstairs, the primary suite has an updated bath and dual closets. Three cornered bedrooms also adorn the upstairs. Enjoy indoor-outdoor living on the newly refinished lower level that extends out to the pool! Lower level offers amazing flexible space - perfect as a recreation/playroom as well as a pool cabana with a wet bar and a full bath for part of your poolside entertaining lifestyle. Lower level also offers a bedroom/au pair/guest room for more flexibility. A laundry room with washer and dryer is also located on the lower level. Recent updates include new appliances, all new paint throughout, bath updates, new window treatments, all new hardware, and much more. Main Street restaurants and shops, Longshore's golf course, tennis courts, pickle ball, Compo Beach and NYC train are all located nearby. Also, enjoy access to Westport's top-rated schools. Great property, Great location, and Great town all which round out the great trifecta.
